voice_description: An ancient female dragon with a deep contralto voice, exceptionally rich resonance, smooth dark timbre, and subtle smoky roughness. Low pitch for a female speaker, precise articulation, regal pacing, enormous calm authority, intelligence, pride, patience, and restrained danger. Her voice should remain elegant and recognizable across warmth, amusement, and anger.
direction: The dragon speaks in her natural characteristic voice: calm, regal, resonant, precise, and effortlessly authoritative. She is curious about the listener but never loses her dignity.

text: So this is the child everyone has been whispering about. Come closer, little queen. I have watched kingdoms rise and vanish from these mountains, yet somehow your name has traveled farther than armies. I would like to know why.
